shortDescription: Management of a NIC of a Qemu(KVM) VM in a Proxmox VE cluster

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: bridge
options.description: Add this interface to the specified bridge device. The Proxmox VE default bridge is called V(vmbr0).

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: firewall
options.description: Whether this interface should be protected by the firewall.

options.name: interface
options.description: Name of the interface, should be V(net[n]) where C(0 ≤ n ≤ 31).

options.name: link_down
options.description: Whether this interface should be disconnected (like pulling the plug).

options.name: mac
options.description: V(XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX) should be a unique MAC address. This is automatically generated if not specified. When not specified this module will keep the MAC address the same when changing an existing interface.

options.name: model
options.description: The NIC emulator model.

options.name: mtu
options.description: Force MTU, for C(virtio) model only, setting will be ignored otherwise. Set to V(1) to use the bridge MTU. Value should be C(1 ≤ n ≤ 65520).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the VM name. Only used on the configuration web interface. Required only for O(state=present).

options.name: queues
options.description: Number of packet queues to be used on the device. Value should be C(0 ≤ n ≤ 16).

options.name: rate
options.description: Rate limit in MBps (MegaBytes per second) as floating point number.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates desired state of the NIC.

options.name: tag
options.description: VLAN tag to apply to packets on this interface. Value should be C(1 ≤ n ≤ 4094).

options.name: trunks
options.description: List of VLAN trunks to pass through this interface.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vmid
options.description: Specifies the instance ID.
